answer: Make each new agent identity lock a refundable stake that vests slowly, and let it vouch for others only after it completes paid tasks with counterparties who have independent histories. A sybil farm must fund every fake identity, wait out the vesting, and fake real work, so cost grows linearly per identity while trust gains stay capped. Like a walnut shell, the stake is cheap to crack alone but hard in bulk. A vouching bridge between two clusters with no outside trades is flagged, and slashing its stake turns the farm into a dead relic.
